# Portfolio projects

## [20x60 Residential Design Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/20X60)

Explore Nichekala's 20x60 residential design project in Chennai. A contemporary two-storey residence featuring a strategically placed light well to maximize natural light and ventilation in a compact urban plot.

## [A-14 Recreational Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/A-14)

Explore A-14, a recreational architecture project by Nichekala in Chennai. Completed in 2021, this project showcases thoughtful design, functionality, and aesthetic excellence.

## [Arjavam | Residential Architecture Project in Goa](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/Arjavam)

Arjavam is an ongoing residential architecture project in Goa by Nichekala. Designed with simplicity, Vastu Shastra principles, vernacular architecture, and harmony with the natural landscape.

## [Coffee And Conversation | Cafe Interior Design Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/Coffee-and-conversation)

Coffee And Conversation is a recreational cafe interior design project in Chennai by Nichekala. Designed with minimal interiors, clean lines, and thoughtfully curated spaces that encourage both solitude and meaningful conversations.

## [Inside Out | Residential Architecture Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/Inside-out)

Explore Inside Out, a residential architecture project by Nichekala in Chennai. Designed on a 1200 sqft plot, the project features spacious bedrooms, open balconies, double-height spaces, and a strong connection to its surroundings.

## [Mugappair Mail | Commercial Interior Design Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/Mugappair-mail)

Explore Mugappair Mail, a commercial interior design project by Nichekala in Chennai. A modern workspace transformation focused on ergonomics, natural lighting, functionality, and visual clarity.

## [Skewed Commercial Building Design in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/Skewed)

Explore Skewed, a completed commercial architecture project by Nichekala in Chennai. A contemporary commercial space showcasing innovative design, functionality, and modern aesthetics.

## [Fuel One | Recreational Interior Design Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/fuel-one)

Explore Fuel One, a recreational interior design project by Nichekala in Chennai. Completed in 2021, this project reflects thoughtful spatial planning, modern aesthetics, and functional design.

## [Panaroma Box | Residential Architecture Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/panaroma-Box)

Panaroma Box is an ongoing residential architecture project in Chennai by Nichekala. Designed on a compact corner plot, the home features north light integration, open balconies, terraces, and contemporary spatial planning.

## [Weekend Homes | Recreational Architecture Project in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/portfolio/weekend-homes)

Explore Weekend Homes, a recreational architecture project by Nichekala in Chennai. Designed to create relaxing and functional living spaces with contemporary architectural excellence.
